attachments.origin_landmark: anterior vertebral bodies C1-T3 (superior oblique, vertical, and inferior oblique fiber groups spanning different multi-level ranges)
attachments.insertion_landmark: anterior vertebral bodies at other levels within the same span (multi-level, segmental)

actions: flexes and slightly rotates the neck
one of the prevertebral 'deep neck flexor' group important for cervical spine segmental stability

functional_compartments.name: Single fiber population

neuromuscular_junction_zone.location_description: mid-belly endplate band -- for where this band lies along the muscle, see motor_endplate_zones

functional_compartments.function_note: Deepest of the prevertebral neck muscles, lying directly on the anterior vertebral bodies from the atlas to T3; part of the deep cervical flexor system whose endurance/motor-control deficits are well documented in chronic neck pain, analogous to multifidus's role in the lumbar spine.
functional_compartments.source: Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell); Terminologia Anatomica (FICAT 1998)

motor_endplate_zones.method: modified Sihler's stain intramuscular nerve-dense region, with muscle-spindle abundance histology
motor_endplate_zones.notes: INDR5a. Proximal of three nerve-dense regions, about 0.74 cm2, from the C2 and C3 branches. NOT recommended as a target: puncture simulation found the increased depth brought the submandibular gland into the path.
motor_endplate_zones.source: Wang D, Chen P, Jia F, Wang M, Wu J, Yang S, 'Division of neuromuscular compartments and localization of the center of the highest region of muscle spindles abundance in deep cervical muscles based on Sihler's staining', Front Neuroanat 18:1340468 (2024), doi:10.3389/fnana.2024.1340468 -- 36 adult cadavers, modified Sihler's staining with muscle-spindle histology, cadaveric puncture simulation and spiral CT localisation

motor_endplate_zones.method: modified Sihler's stain intramuscular nerve-dense region, with muscle-spindle abundance histology
motor_endplate_zones.notes: INDR5b. Middle of three, about 0.55 cm2, from the C4 branch. Centre of highest spindle abundance at 44.75% of muscle length, in its middle third. Unobstructed on puncture simulation; the recommended target.
motor_endplate_zones.source: Wang D, Chen P, Jia F, Wang M, Wu J, Yang S, 'Division of neuromuscular compartments and localization of the center of the highest region of muscle spindles abundance in deep cervical muscles based on Sihler's staining', Front Neuroanat 18:1340468 (2024), doi:10.3389/fnana.2024.1340468 -- 36 adult cadavers, modified Sihler's staining with muscle-spindle histology, cadaveric puncture simulation and spiral CT localisation

motor_endplate_zones.method: modified Sihler's stain intramuscular nerve-dense region, with muscle-spindle abundance histology
motor_endplate_zones.notes: INDR5c. Distal of three, about 0.30 cm2, from the C5 branch. NOT recommended as a target: puncture simulation found it could penetrate the pleural cavity and injure the lung apex.
motor_endplate_zones.source: Wang D, Chen P, Jia F, Wang M, Wu J, Yang S, 'Division of neuromuscular compartments and localization of the center of the highest region of muscle spindles abundance in deep cervical muscles based on Sihler's staining', Front Neuroanat 18:1340468 (2024), doi:10.3389/fnana.2024.1340468 -- 36 adult cadavers, modified Sihler's staining with muscle-spindle histology, cadaveric puncture simulation and spiral CT localisation

injection_target_points.label: centre of the region of highest muscle spindle abundance
injection_target_points.transverse_line_from: lowest point of the jugular notch
injection_target_points.longitudinal_line_from: lowest point of the jugular notch
injection_target_points.needle_path: Perpendicular to the skin at the level of the hyoid bone, through skin, subcutaneous fat and platysma, passing between the lateral edge of the thyroid cartilage plate and the medial side of the common carotid artery.
structures_at_risk: pleura and lung apex (at the more distal INDR5c)
injection_target_points.method: modified Sihler's stain intramuscular nerve-dense region, with muscle-spindle abundance histology, localised by spiral CT with barium sulphate labelling
injection_target_points.notes: The lateral edge of the thyroid cartilage plate is the source's landmark for the entry interval. Depth is reported by the source in centimetres, as the mean of its own cadaver sample, so unlike a percentage it does not scale with the patient. Treat it as the depth to expect on the screen, not a setting to dial in. Deep cervical muscles sit under complex structures and the source recommends ultrasound guidance for all of them. Divided into three neuromuscular compartments, C2-C3, C4 and C5, with limited C6 innervation at the insertion. When the muscle is used as a flap to repair oesophageal perforation after cervical spine surgery, the source recommends selecting the compartment whose area matches the defect. About 0.4 units at this target, the smallest of the five.
injection_target_points.source: Wang D, Chen P, Jia F, Wang M, Wu J, Yang S, 'Division of neuromuscular compartments and localization of the center of the highest region of muscle spindles abundance in deep cervical muscles based on Sihler's staining', Front Neuroanat 18:1340468 (2024), doi:10.3389/fnana.2024.1340468 -- 36 adult cadavers, modified Sihler's staining with muscle-spindle histology, cadaveric puncture simulation and spiral CT localisation
